outcome: Health service use (outpatient physician visits, non-physician visits, emergency department visits, prescription drug use, hospital admissions)
cohort: Pregnant patients with and without CHD, matched 1:1 by age, sex, and insurance enrollment year, from the Merative MarketScan commercial insurance database (2010-2016)
finding: Pregnancies in patients with CHD were associated with significantly higher healthcare use and costs compared to pregnancies in patients without CHD.
